commit.merge_subject: merge: editor back scrim and playback before after

description:
The before/after press-hold only worked while paused: canHold
rejected playing clips because a neutral hold render would be
superseded by the playback loop within one frame. Owner request
2026-11-11: the hold works during playback too.

A hold while playing now pauses the wall clock first (isPlaying =
false, which the playback loop and the audio transport both key on,
so video and sound stop cleanly at the current position - the loop
is not fought frame-by-frame), then renders the neutral frame at the
paused tier through the cached path. Release re-renders the graded
frame and resumes playback from the held position (the existing
play-from-position logic; PlaybackStarted stands the drag tier down
like the play button). A finger drag past the touch slop during the
hold cancels it through the same end path as release - a moving
